title: Switch Distance
statement: A panel of switches is stored as a whole number: bit i is switch i, 1 for on. Return how many switches must be flipped to change panel `a` into panel `b`.

answerKey.pattern: XOR marks the differing bits; count its 1 bits
keyPoints: a ^ b has a 1 exactly where a and b differ
Count the 1 bits of a ^ b, for example with n & (n - 1)
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Compare the two binary strings character by character after padding

hints: Which bit operation is 1 exactly where two bits differ?
XOR. Now count the 1 bits of the result.
Use the lit-windows trick: x = x & (x − 1) until x is 0.
